beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is the little village of Bethany, just outside Jerusalem. One evening, Jesus came here to the home of two sisters, Martha and Mary, and Martha gladly welcomed him in.

timing.text: This is the little village of Bethany, just outside Jerusalem.
One evening, Jesus came here to the home of two sisters, Martha and Mary, and Martha gladly welcomed him in.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In that day, hosting a guest like this was a real honor, and a great deal of work. There was a meal to cook, water to carry, and a whole house to ready. Martha took all of it onto herself.

timing.text: In that day, hosting a guest like this was a real honor, and a great deal of work.
There was a meal to cook, water to carry, and a whole house to ready.
Martha took all of it onto herself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So Martha threw herself into the serving. Stirring, carrying, cleaning, fixing, moving without a pause, giving this guest everything she thought he deserved.

timing.text: So Martha threw herself into the serving.
Stirring, carrying, cleaning, fixing, moving without a pause, giving this guest everything she thought he deserved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But little by little, the joy of having him there got buried under the weight of getting it all just right. Her hands stayed busy while, inside, she wound tighter and tighter.

timing.text: But little by little, the joy of having him there got buried under the weight of getting it all just right.
Her hands stayed busy while, inside, she wound tighter and tighter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Her sister Mary had made a completely different choice. She sat down on the floor at Jesus's feet, and she simply listened to every word he said.

timing.text: Her sister Mary had made a completely different choice.
She sat down on the floor at Jesus's feet, and she simply listened to every word he said.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Back then, sitting at a teacher's feet was the place a student sat, and it was not a place people expected a woman to take. Mary took it anyway. She wanted to be near him more than anything else that night.

timing.text: Back then, sitting at a teacher's feet was the place a student sat, and it was not a place people expected a woman to take.
Mary took it anyway.
She wanted to be near him more than anything else that night.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meanwhile Martha, worn thin, finally reached her breaking point. She stopped, looked at her sister just sitting there, and said out loud, in front of everyone, exactly what she was feeling.

timing.text: Meanwhile Martha, worn thin, finally reached her breaking point.
She stopped, looked at her sister just sitting there, and said out loud, in front of everyone, exactly what she was feeling.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do all of this work by myself? Tell her to get up and help me.

timing.text: Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do all of this work by myself?
Tell her to get up and help me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The whole room went quiet. And Jesus answered her, not with a scolding, but with her own name, said twice, and said gently.

timing.text: The whole room went quiet.
And Jesus answered her, not with a scolding, but with her own name, said twice, and said gently.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

timing.text: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He did not scold her for serving, and he was never upset that she worked so hard. What troubled him was the worry underneath it, the anxiety that was pulling her apart. And the quiet thing Mary had chosen, just being with him, he promised no one would ever take away from her.

timing.text: He did not scold her for serving, and he was never upset that she worked so hard.
What troubled him was the worry underneath it, the anxiety that was pulling her apart.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was not picking one sister over the other. He was telling a woman he loved that she did not have to earn her place near him by working herself ragged. She was allowed to stop, and sit, and simply be with him, the same as her sister.

timing.text: He was not picking one sister over the other.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He never scolded the serving. He worried about the worry. That is the kind of God he is.

card.text: Worried and troubled about many things, or sitting down long enough to listen. Which one sounds more like your life right now?
